## Goal
Describe the goal of the prototype in one sentence.

## Inputs
- Data or files to use
- Example prompts

## Constraints
- Timebox: e.g., 2 hours
- Must not change production files

## Acceptance Criteria
- README in the branch documenting prompts and sample outputs
- Working UI component or JSON output demonstrating the prototype

Suggested branch name: ai/<short>-prototype
